title: River Development Agent Governed Executor Integration Verification Foundation
objective: Verify deterministically and fail closed that the DEV-291 governed executor integration decision preserves default-deny semantics and cannot silently elevate an unauthorized apply request into executable mutation authority.
requiredInvariants: effective mode must never be apply when predecessor authorization is false
effective mode must never be apply when predecessor readiness is false
effective mode must never be apply when predecessor trust is false
effective mode must never be apply when authorizationSatisfied is false
blocked predecessor state must fail verification
successful verification grants no execution authority
validationRequirements: valid DEV-291 authorized apply decision verifies
apply effective mode with unauthorized predecessor fails verification
predecessor that may create authorization fails verification
predecessor that may expand scope fails verification
predecessor that may modify repository fails verification
predecessor that may execute operation fails verification
successful verification itself grants no execution capability
completionStandard: DEV-292 is complete when deterministic verification proves that only internally consistent DEV-291 governed integration decisions verify successfully and that verification itself cannot authorize, execute, mutate, push, deploy, or expand scope.
